tvShow.name: Murders in...
tvShow.overview: Murders in... is a collection of French-Belgian police TV movies taking place each time in a different French city and region.

episodes.name: Murder In Saint Malo
episodes.overview: Police captain Gwenaële Garrec is investigating about the discovery of a corpse on the beach of Saint-Malo. She tries to convince her temporary teammate, captain Eric Vautier, that their case is more complicated that it seems.

episodes.name: Murder in Basque Country
episodes.overview: The corpse of a woman appears in a cave near the sea in Saint-Jean-de-Luz. Captain Marie Daguerre will investigate accompanied by the Commander Becker, a rough Parisian police that prove to be the father of the main suspect, in turn disappeared.

episodes.name: Murder in Rocamadour
episodes.overview: A dead body is found on the stairs leading to the sanctuary esplanade of the town of Rocamadour. Before being killed, he was apparently forced to undergo an expiatory pilgrimage as in the Middle Ages and to climb on his knees the 216 steps of the staircase. But what sin could this man have possibly committed to deserve such a sentence?

episodes.name: Murder In Rouen
episodes.overview: A police captain learns that his ailing father could be connected to a murder at Rouen Abbey.

episodes.name: Murder on Yeu Island
episodes.overview: A famous sailor and her son discover a headless corpse close to Yeu Island.

episodes.name: Murder In Collioure
episodes.overview: In a grisly murder that evokes local legend, a woman rolls to her death in a barrel.

episodes.name: Murder In La Rochelle
episodes.overview: Childhood cruelties from decades ago fuel revenge in La Rochelle.

episodes.name: Murder In Burgundy
episodes.overview: A police chief fights to reopen the investigation into her father's death.

episodes.name: Murder In Avignon
episodes.overview: A top investigator teams up with her aunt to solve a case involving a skeleton found in papal vault.

episodes.name: Murder on L'ile de Re
episodes.overview: A man dressed as a convict is found dead on a beach near the citadel.

episodes.name: Murder on Lake Geneva
episodes.overview: A Swiss and a French detective team up to investigate a deliberate drowning on Lake Geneva.

episodes.name: Murder In La Ciotat
episodes.overview: A murder in a warehouse may be linked to a shipyard accident 30 years prior.

episodes.name: Murder In Martinique
episodes.overview: A forensics trainer lends a hand to a homicide case that may shed light on her own family's past.

episodes.name: Murder In Grasse
episodes.overview: When a perfumer is found dead in a fragrance tank, the investigation opens up a related cold case.

episodes.name: Murder In Aix-en-Provence
episodes.overview: A man is tortured and crucified, with the only clues coming from a stolen Nostradamus manuscript.

episodes.name: Murder In Strasbourg
episodes.overview: Former sweethearts investigate the death of a winemaker discovered inside a vat with his eyes glued shut.

episodes.name: Murder In Hossegor
episodes.overview: A local aristocrat is found murdered in a way that depicts a 600-year-old legend.

episodes.name: Murders in Auvergne
episodes.overview: A woman’s body is found nearby the Lake Pavin in the Auvergne region. The staging of the murder baffles the investigators in its resemblance to the legend of the lake, whereby the sinners of Besse, having provoked God’s anger, were buried alive and then covered in the Devil’s tears.

episodes.name: Murder In Sarlat
episodes.overview: The son of a food manufacturer is murdered with a pitchfork, suggesting deaths inflicted in a 17th century rebellion.

episodes.name: Murder In Orleans
episodes.overview: A young woman portraying Joan of Arc is shot dead by an arrow during a parade through Orleans.

episodes.name: Murder In Oleron
episodes.overview: A 60-year-old man lies dead in a cemetery next to an oyster shell engraved with his name.

episodes.name: Murder In Cornouaille
episodes.overview: Husband and wife investigators look into the death of a woman wearing the costume of a Celtic princess.

episodes.name: Murder In Lorraine
episodes.overview: A corpse clutching a crystal chess piece is found in the old fortress of Bitche.

episodes.name: Murder In Colmar
episodes.overview: A surgeon investigates his estranged son's death for the sake of his grandson.

episodes.name: Murder In Lille
episodes.overview: A few hours before a museum event, a sculpture appears to bleed and the artist's corpse is found inside.

episodes.name: Murder on Belle-Ile
episodes.overview: A body lies on the moors, next to a legendary menhir.

episodes.name: Murder In Cotentin
episodes.overview: Sprigs of broom around a murder victim suggest an ancient legend.

episodes.name: Murder In The Jura Mountains
episodes.overview: The body of a healer is found covered in white petals.

episodes.name: Murder In Correze
episodes.overview: The historic procession of Saint-Jean in the city of Tulle is disrupted by dead bodies.

episodes.name: Murders at La Pointe du Raz
Murder in Amiens
episodes.overview: In the heart of the Amiens hortillonnages, on a Nautilus-shaped ride gondola, floats the lifeless body of Charlotte Jelenski. Who could have attacked this quiet woman, who was leading an ambitious amusement park project about Jules Verne's work?
